g.title: HR_TIMESHEETDAYACTIVITIES
g.text: Timesheet Day Activities - The timesheet day activities entity.
Start date and time of the activity for that day.
End date and time of the activity for that day.
The id of the time tracker activity associated to the user for a specific day.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_TIMESHEETDAY
g.text: Timesheet Day - The timesheet day entity
Scheduled hours for this timesheet day.
Early Entry (outside the tolerance before entry time)
Late Entry (outside the tolerance after entry time)
Early Exit (outside the tolerance before exit time)
Late Exit (outside the tolerance after exit time)
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
